takes.title: Basketball signals in profile
takes.actionDescription: After an initial arms-out frame, the performer stands side-on and alternates chest-level, forward and overhead arm signals with pauses, ending standing.
takes.reviewNote: Source starts with 48 all-zero captured frames. First usable motion is recorded at source frame 49.

takes.title: I'm a Little Teapot gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing and acts out the rhyme with hands near the chest and hips, raised arms, a deep sideways bend and a return to standing.

takes.title: Alaskan vacation pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing and performs a sequence of wide arm sweeps, raised hands, head-level gestures and reaches, then lowers the arms and finishes upright.

takes.title: Cock Robin rhyme gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with a hand raised and performs a long series of chest and head-level gestures, overhead reaches and forward bends, finishing with hands near the chest.

takes.title: Basketball signals with wide stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a wide stance with arms crossed in front, alternates chest-level, outward and overhead signals with pauses, then finishes standing.

takes.title: I'm a Little Teapot gestures and bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms open, gestures around the head and chest, lifts the arms, bends sideways, and returns upright with hands near the chest.

takes.title: Cock Robin rhyme pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands near the face, performs a long sequence of sweeping, head-level and overhead gestures with occasional bends, and finishes with hands together near the chest.

takes.title: Prairie dog pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing with hands near the chest, repeatedly crouches low and rises with hands held close, ending in another knee bend.

takes.title: Whale pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, repeatedly folds forward with hands near the hips or thighs and rises, finishing in a forward lean.

takes.title: Bear pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright with bent arms, alternates broad arm gestures and side bends, then remains folded forward with repeated low reaches before rising.

takes.title: Dog pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing with hands near the face, repeatedly tilts the head and moves the hands around the face and chest, ending with the head lowered.

takes.title: Snake pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts leaning sideways with hands together, repeatedly sways and bends while moving the hands in front of the body, and finishes leaning with the arms extended.

takes.title: Chicken pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright with bent arms near the chest, makes repeated forward bends and head-level gestures, then holds both hands on or above the head through the end.

takes.title: Monkey pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing with bent arms, repeatedly leans sideways, gestures near the head and hips and reaches outward, ending in another extended-arm gesture.

takes.title: Mouse pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing with both hands near the mouth, repeats small hand and head movements while shifting weight, and finishes with hands near the chest.

takes.title: Cat pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a wide stance with hands near the face, repeatedly tilts the head and moves the hands around the cheeks and mouth, ending with hands together near the chin.

takes.title: Elephant pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, raises one arm overhead, folds forward and repeatedly extends the arm downward, then rises and lifts the arm again through the end.

takes.title: Dinosaur pantomime
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing with hands near the face, repeats forward leans and bent-knee movements with hands held up, then rises and continues gesturing through the end.
